description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Permanently delete past run history — all of it, everything older than a date, or all but the newest N runs. There is no undo. Requires confirm: true.

before.description: Delete only runs that ended before this time. Accepts an ISO timestamp, a clock time read in the kitchen's timezone (resolved to today), or a relative form ('7d ago', '-24h'). Omit to consider all runs.

confirm.description: Must be true. Guards against an accidental wipe: there is no undo and no client-side backup.

entries.description: Delete exactly these history entry ids (from list_history).

keepLatest.description: Keep only the N most recent runs and delete the rest.

name: clear_history

delivery.description: How recently the phone checked in, so you never imply it has seen this.

lastSyncAgo.description: Last sync in words, e.g. '2m ago'.

notified.description: A push about this change went out.

note.description: What just happened, in one line.

oldestRemainingAt.description: When the oldest surviving run ended, ISO 8601.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Clear run history
